description: A deployment left its configuration file and its entrypoint script world-writable. FILESYS-0003 fails on both. The fixture also carries a symlink, which is what proves symlinks are excluded from the interest: a symlink's own mode is lrwxrwxrwx and the kernel ignores it, so including them would report every symlink on a host as world-writable and bury the two real findings among thousands of false ones.
